title: Vector and Matrix with operators
summary: A small linear-algebra library with natural syntax, a + b, M * v, m(i, j), stream output, used to compute a portfolio's variance wᵀΣw.

steps.title: Vector
hints: Store a `std::vector<double>`: copy, assignment and destructor come for free (the rule of zero).
Two `operator[]` overloads, const and non-const. `v_.at(i)` gives bounds checking.
Accept a brace list with a constructor taking `std::initializer_list<double>`.

steps.title: Matrix
hints: Store the elements row-major in one `std::vector<double>`: element (i, j) is at `i * cols + j`.
Use `operator()(i, j)` for indexing. `operator[]` with two arguments is only allowed from C++23.
Matrix × matrix: three nested loops, `out(i, j) += a(i, k) * b(k, j)`.
